verdict.rationale: An AI-training opt-out is a fair privacy question for an email service that holds user content, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack contains no documentation of any setting or policy that keeps Outlook user data out of AI model training. The only privacy-adjacent item concerns advertising preferences on free accounts, which is a different control and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
